data.name: Awlya
data.gender_notes: Awlya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who is a guide or protector. The name Awlya carries the meaning “Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Awlya usually hope their child will grow to embody guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Awlya refers to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his Companions, who are the guides and protectors for Muslims. The name reminds us to strive to be like them in our actions and to seek their guidance in our lives.
data.etymology: Awlya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awlya total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أولياء
in_arabic.meaning: أولياء الله تعالى المقربون من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أولياء مشتق من الألفة والولاية، ويشير إلى القرباء من الله تعالى والمحبين له، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: 'أُولَٰئِكَ أَوْلِيَاءُ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُم يَحْزَنُونَ'

in_urdu.name: اولیاء
in_urdu.long_meaning: اولیاء کا مطلب ہے وہ لوگ جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے قریب ہیں، اور اللہ کی محبت میں ہیں، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں کہا گیا ہے: 'أُولَٰئِكَ أَوْلِيَاءُ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُم يَحْزَنُونَ'، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अवलिया
in_hindi.meaning: अवलिया मतलब अल्लाह के करीब लोग
in_hindi.long_meaning: अवलिया नाम का अर्थ है अल्लाह के प्रिय और करीब लोग, जो अल्लाह की मोहब्बत में होते हैं और अल्लाह के साथ घनिष्ठ संबंध रखते हैं, जैसा कि कुरआन में उल्लेख है: 'أُولَٰئِكَ أَوْلِيَاءُ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُم يَحْزَنُونَ'

in_pashto.name: اولیاء
in_pashto.long_meaning: اولیاء د الله تعالیٰ هغه کسان دي چی د الله سره مینه لري او د الله محبت کې دي، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کریم کې راغلي: 'أُولَٰئِكَ أَوْلِيَاءُ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُم يَحْزَنُونَ'

in_english.name: Awlya
in_english.meaning: Close ones, beloved, and pious individuals
in_english.long_meaning: The name Awlya originates from Arabic roots 'aw-la-yā', meaning close ones or beloved. In Islamic context, Awlya refers to pious individuals who are close to Allah. The Quran mentions 'awliyā'' in several verses, emphasizing their spiritual proximity to Allah and their righteous nature.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Awlya" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is used to refer to those individuals who are loved and admired for their piety and close connection to Allah. The concept of Awlyas is deeply rooted in Sufism, the mystical and spiritual branch of Islam, and is often associated with saints and scholars who have devoted their lives to seeking knowledge and drawing closer to Allah. The term is also used to describe those individuals who provide guidance, support, and protection to their communities and are respected for their wisdom and knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the term "Awlya" represents a deeper connection to Allah and a strong commitment to living a pious and God-conscious life. An Awlya is someone who has dedicated their life to seeking knowledge, following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and striving to draw closer to Allah. They serve as models of piety and exemplify the spiritual virtues of love, patience, humility, and devotion. Through their words and actions, Awlyas inspire others to strive for spiritual growth and provide guidance and support on the path to Allah. They are considerated as a bridge between the people and Allah, who intercede on behalf of their communities, and bring blessings to the people, and are always remembered with love and respect.
